import numpy as np
w=0.5041
C=np.cos(w*t); S=np.sin(w*t)
base=[np.ones_like(t),x,x**2,x**3,v,v*v,np.log(v)]
def run(extra,name):
    Z=np.column_stack(base+extra)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(Z,dv_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dv_dt-Z@c
    print(name, round(np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dv_dt),6))
    return c
